text.paragraph: Ibuprofen 100 mg (NSAID)1
1nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug
Pain reliever/fever reducer
temporarily:

list.item: relieves minor aches and pains due to the common cold, flu, sore throat, headache and toothache
reduces fever

text.paragraph: Ibuprofen may cause a severe allergic reaction, especially in people allergic to aspirin.
Symptoms may include:

list.item: hives
facial swelling
asthma (wheezing)
shock
skin reddening
rash
blisters

text.paragraph: If an allergic reaction occurs, stop use and seek medical help right away.
This product contains an NSAID, which may cause severe stomach bleeding. The chance is higher if your child:

list.item: has had stomach ulcers or bleeding problems
takes a blood thinning (anticoagulant) or steroid drug
takes other drugs containing prescription or nonprescription NSAIDs (aspirin, ibuprofen, naproxen, or others)
takes more or for a longer time than directed

text.paragraph: NSAIDs, except aspirin, increase the risk of heart attack, heart failure, and stroke. These can be fatal. The risk is higher if you use more than directed or for longer than directed.

Severe or persistent sore throat or sore throat accompanied by high fever, headache, nausea, and vomiting may be serious. Consult doctor promptly. Do not use more than 2 days or administer to children under 3 years of age unless directed by doctor.

list.item: if the child has ever had an allergic reaction to ibuprofen or any other pain reliever/fever reducer
right before or after heart surgery

title.content: Ask a doctor before use if

list.item: stomach bleeding warning applies to your child
child has a history of stomach problems, such as heartburn
child has problems or serious side effects from taking pain relievers or fever reducers
child has not been drinking fluids
child has lost a lot of fluid due to vomiting or diarrhea
child has high blood pressure, heart disease, liver cirrhosis, kidney disease, or had a stroke
child has asthma
child is taking a diuretic
